{{Quote|When Bledsoe's took my ''father'', there was no ''son'' to inherit the business!|Anduvil|<ref name="TS" />}}
'''Anduvil's father''' was an [[Ogemite/Legends|Ogemite]] [[Merchant/Legends|trader]]. He died of [[Bledsoe's disease]]. He had no son, leaving his daughter [[Anduvil]] to inherit the family business.<ref name="TS" />
